channel.title: Hutch
channel.description: Updates for Hutch — multi-tool macOS utility from Coursion. Public downloads are paused.

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
• Hutch is now a paid app: $29 once, for three Macs, covering every 1.x release. Every tool works in full for 14 days, then Toggles, Window Manager and Browser Picker stay free forever.
  • Buy Hutch from the site. Your key appears on the thanks page and arrives by email.
  • Activate in Hutch: the button in your licence email opens Settings → Licence with the key filled in.
  • One licence covers three Macs. Release one from Settings → Licence any time, or add more for $4.99 each.
  • Keys are checked on your Mac. No account, no login, no server that can lock you out.
  • Presets: pick Everything, Launcher & windows or Minimal. Tools you switch off don't load at all: no hotkeys, no background work.
  • Permissions on demand: Hutch asks only for what your enabled tools need, and tells you when a permission is no longer used.
  • Help improve Hutch: anonymous crash reports and usage counts, asked openly during setup, each one click off.
  • What's New for your tools: changes to the tools you use come first.
  • Clean uninstall: Settings → General → Uninstall Hutch removes the app, its settings and its permissions.
  • Every language, fully translated: all 28 languages now cover the whole app.
  • Compact: a third, launcher-style look next to Glass and Ledger.
  • Window Manager profiles: named layouts per Mac. Your MacBook and your desk Mac each keep their own.
  • Switch any tool off: its hotkeys are released and it leaves Pounce.
  • Appearance has its own settings page, and every panel follows the style you pick.
  • Pounce's right-hand badge says what ⏎ will do.
  • Hutch notices if it loses its own shortcuts and offers to restore them.
  • macOS 27: Focus and Night Shift toggles, and simulators open in Device Hub.
  • Turning on iCloud sync on a new Mac now adopts your profile without asking which side to keep.
  • The camera and microphone indicators could take the whole app down.
  • A hung helper process no longer freezes Hutch.
  • Faster typing in Pounce, and the Keychain is off the main thread.
  • Bug reports go to feedback@coursion.studio.
